name: ai.servicefront/front-desk
title: ServiceFront
description: Ask about a local service business on ServiceFront: hours, service area, owner-confirmed prices.

tools.name: searchBusinesses
tools.description: Find a verified ServiceFront business by name (or part of it) and get its businessId for the other tools. Returns up to 5 matches with name, trade, and front-desk URL.

query.description: The business name, or part of it.

tools.name: getBusinessInfo
tools.description: Owner-verified facts for one business: trade, service area, hours, contact, services with confirmed prices. Absent fields are NOT owner-confirmed — don't state them as facts. No tool on this address takes a customer's contact details. To be called back or to ask for a time, the customer goes to the business: its front desk page (origin in the reply) or its confirmed phone.

businessId.description: The business's ServiceFront slug, the first label of its <slug>.servicefront.ai address. Find it with searchBusinesses if you only know the name.

tools.name: getQuote
tools.description: The owner-confirmed price for one of a business's services, by service name (ideally a name from getBusinessInfo). grounded:false means no confirmed price exists — never invent one; for an exact quote the customer asks the business on its front desk page (origin in getBusinessInfo) or calls its confirmed phone.

businessId.description: The business's ServiceFront slug, the first label of its <slug>.servicefront.ai address. Find it with searchBusinesses if you only know the name.

service.description: The service to price — ideally one of the business's listed service names.

tools.name: aboutServiceFront
tools.description: What ServiceFront is, for a service business owner (or their AI assistant) looking for an AI front desk: who it's for, how setup works, what it answers, and what it doesn't do yet. No input. For prices call getPricing; for a demo call sampleConversation.

tools.name: getPricing
tools.description: ServiceFront's own plans and limits (Free $0, Basic $59): what each includes and what's never charged for. No input. The same content as https://servicefront.ai/pricing.md.

tools.name: howToSetUp
tools.description: How a service business owner sets up their own ServiceFront front desk: the steps, the <slug>.servicefront.ai address it goes live at, and the one-line widget for their website. No input. The owner signs up themselves; no tool creates an account.

tools.name: sampleConversation
tools.description: A sample conversation between a homeowner and a ServiceFront front desk in one trade: the question, the answer, urgency triage, and the captured lead. The business in it is a made-up example. Ready trades: plumbing; any other trade says it isn't ready yet and returns a ready trade's sample as a labeled stand-in.
